name: indian_mutton_curry
title: Indian Mutton Curry 🍖
ingredients: Spices: turmeric, chili powder, coriander, garam masala 🌶️
preparation: Heat mustard oil until it smokes lightly.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown.
Mix in ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and spices, cook until oil separates.
Add mutton pieces, stir well, and cook on medium heat.
Pour water, cover, and simmer until mutton is tender.
Finish with garam masala and garnish with coriander leaves.
